items.title: Russia frees 74-year-old American Stephen Hubbard captured in occupied Ukraine
items.brief: Russia has freed Stephen Hubbard, an American who had been imprisoned in Russia for more than four years on charges of fighting as a mercenary in Ukraine following a direct plea from US President Donald Trump.

items.title: A chemical tank explodes in Ohio, forcing evacuations and prompting fears of another blast
items.brief: A chemical tank exploded in Toledo, Ohio, forcing hundreds of residents to evacuate their homes or shelter in place due to fears of a toxic release, and the mayor warned Wednesday that it may still be explosive.
